verdict.rationale: TruffleHog has a scriptable CLI and documented pre-commit hooks. These include a `--fail` exit mode and a global `core.hooksPath` setup, so commits made by a coding agent would be scanned for secrets before they land. However, nothing in the evidence describes a coding-agent integration; the wiring relies on generic git hooks or CLI invocation. Scope is also limited to secrets rather than broader code issues. Missing for 10: agent-specific integration (MCP server, agent hook or plugin docs), an llms.txt or machine-readable docs for agents, coverage beyond secret detection, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent workflows.
